content.text: The Los Angeles Lakers and Houston Rockets square-off on Monday night in a game that could be a Western Conference playoff preview. In a potential playoff preview in the Western Conference, the Los Angeles Lakers (42-25) visit the Houston Rockets (41-25) at the Toyota Center on Monday. These teams sit right next to each other in the Western Conference standings entering play – the Lakers are in third place, with the Rockets 0.5 games back in fourth. They’re part of a tight pack of teams in the middle of the playoff picture – the third place Lakers and seventh place Phoenix Suns are separated by a total of three games.
